Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah
O Bestower of Faith, O Allah
O Master of all masters, O Allah
O Giver of life, O Allah
O Causer of death, O Allah
O Bestower of blessings, O Allah
O Possessor of Power, O Allah
O Lord of the Ways of Ascent, O Allah
O Lord of Majesty, O Allah
O Lord of Honor, O Allah
O Doer of what He wills, O Allah

Arabic text: اَسْئَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
Translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And bestow upon me Your pleasure
And pardon me through Your forbearance

Arabic text: وَتُوَسِّعَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الْحَلاَلِ الطَّيِّبِ
Translation: And expand for me from Your lawful and pure provision

Arabic text: وَمِنْ حَيْثُ اَحْتَسِبُ وَمِنْ حَيْثُ لَا اَحْتَسِبُ
Translation: From where I expect and from where I do not expect

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ عَبْدُكَ لَيْسَ لِيْ اَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ
Translation: For I am Your servant, I have no one besides You
And there is no one I can ask other than You
O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظيمِ
Translation: There is no power except with Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: O Allah, O Allah, O Allah

Arabic text: يَا رَبُّ يَا رَبُّ يَا رَبُّ
Translation: O Lord, O Lord, O Lord
Through You every need is fulfilled

Arabic text: اَسْئَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ فِيْ مَخْزُوْنِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: I ask You by every name in the treasure of the unseen with You
And by the names renowned with You
Written on the pavilions of Your Throne

Arabic text: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to accept from me the month of Ramadan

Arabic text: وَتَكْتُبَنِيْ مِنَ الْوَافِدِيْنَ إِلٰى بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
Translation: And write me among those who visit Your Sacred House
And forgive me for my grave sins

Arabic text: وَتَسْتَخْرِجَ لِيْ يَا رَبِّ كُنُوْزَكَ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
Translation: And bring forth for me, O Lord, Your treasures, O Most Beneficent
